## Products
1. Magnetic separators — grate, hopper/round grate, drawer, bullet, pulley, plate, magnetic bars/tubes, drum. Typical rare-earth field 10,000–13,000 gauss. Food-grade options for food plants.
2. NdFeB (neodymium) grades N35–N52
2b. SmCo (samarium cobalt) SmCo5 / Sm2Co17 — high temperature & corrosion; page https://magnets.com.my/smco-magnets.html
2x. NdFeB (neodymium) rare-earth magnets — sintered grades N35–N52; coatings and custom sizes on request.
3. Lifting magnets — permanent and electro; designed around ~3:1 safety factor; capacities sized to load.

## Buyers
Factories in food processing, plastics, recycling, chemicals, bulk materials, steel handling, OEMs and MRO across Malaysia. ASEAN inquiries welcome.
